The infant was born at term, has no history of serious illness, and her immunizations are up to date. The current medication includes acetaminophen.

speaker: Doctor

text: The fever resolving before the rash appears is classic for roseola infantum. To confirm this diagnosis, I will request a visual inspection of the rash. REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Doctor
text: The clinical presentation of a high fever followed by a rash after the fever subsides, along with a febrile seizure, is classic for Roseola Infantum (Exanthem Subitum) caused by HHV-6. DIAGNOSIS READY: Roseola Infantum
